title: Disinfecting wastewater that reaches the ocean
summary: At the October 19 meeting, a testifier asked members to advance $1.8 million for design work on UV disinfection and urged against adding flow to the existing plant until it has effective disinfection. The testifier said the Kahului plant stopped all disinfection in 2018. Earlier, on October 7, another testifier asked for $4 million for UV disinfection in South Maui.
